tasks.corrected_reference_answer: For a categorical feature, the splitter includes the missing bin as a category only if its support passes the threshold (sklearn/ensemble/_hist_gradient_boosting/splitting.pyx:967-983). It scans prefixes from both ends of a sorted category ordering, not every possible subset (lines 995-1007). The selected categories are recorded in left_cat_bitset; when missing values are present, missing_go_to_left is determined by membership of missing_values_bin_idx in that bitset (lines 1072-1084). Thus a selected missing bin goes left, otherwise right. Numerical splitting has separate missing-direction logic.
